Record Class ArtifactInput

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
network.ike.knowledge.spi.ArtifactInput
Record Components:
role - the artifact's role in assembly
path - the artifact file, or for a ArtifactInput.Role.SOURCE the release file or directory
importer - for a ArtifactInput.Role.SOURCE, the name of the knowledge importer that reads it; empty for every other role
options - for a ArtifactInput.Role.SOURCE, the importer's options by name; empty otherwise
coordinate - the Maven coordinate the artifact was resolved from, as written (g:a[:extension[:classifier]]:v); empty for a file named by path. The assembly records it in the knowledge base it builds (IKE-Network/ike-issues#1304).
resolvedVersion - the version the coordinate resolved to: for a snapshot, its timestamped version (1-20261017.165120-21); empty for a file named by path
public record ArtifactInput(ArtifactInput.Role role, Path path, Optional<String> importer, Map<String,String> options, Optional<String> coordinate, Optional<String> resolvedVersion) extends Record
One knowledge artifact in an ordered input list — list position is load order, the fit contract: the base comes first so every identity later inputs reference is present, and each change set then merges by public id.

    • ArtifactInput

      public ArtifactInput(ArtifactInput.Role role, Path path, Optional<String> importer, Map<String,String> options, Optional<String> coordinate, Optional<String> resolvedVersion)
      Validates the components: a ArtifactInput.Role.SOURCE names its importer, and no other role names one or carries options.
      Parameters:
      role - the artifact's role in assembly
      path - the artifact
      importer - the importer's name, for a source
      options - the importer's options, for a source
      coordinate - the Maven coordinate the artifact was resolved from, if any
      resolvedVersion - the version the coordinate resolved to, if any
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if a component is null
      IllegalArgumentException - if a source names no importer, or another role names one

    • requireSeedFirstOnly

      public static void requireSeedFirstOnly(List<ArtifactInput> inputs)
      Enforces the seed rule on an ordered input list: a ArtifactInput.Role.STORE_SEED is the base layer and is valid only in first position.
      Parameters:
      inputs - the ordered inputs
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if a ArtifactInput.Role.STORE_SEED appears after the first position
